status: source-controlled face-following backing with upper shoulder and tangent lower stem fairing; eagle outline follows S01
units: full-size feet; SOMA registers millimetres at 304.8 mm/ft

registration.vertical_anchor: S04 post deck grid y318.5 at the unchanged S05 Samson station; spar centre about y310.0

classification.upper_outer: Continuous outer upper timber line immediately below the item-11 headrail and above the decorated fascia; includes the three visible fastening blocks. The headrail line itself is not used as the timber boundary.
classification.lower_outer: Decorated-face lower edge plus a small margin. The former S04 outer lower line is not used as the backing bottom; using it produced the over-deep board below the decorated section. The S04 line remains a source silhouette reference only.
classification.face_upper_lower: Existing S01-V03 transferred decorated-face contours; retained unchanged and nested inside this envelope.
classification.aft_root: Existing longhead root station; the envelope closes at the unchanged stem/head interface.
classification.forward_head: Forward closure follows the source head/eagle silhouette and must contain the S01 face; the last segment is an inferred fitted transition.
classification.rejected: Item-1 bowsprit, item-11 headrail line, dashed cable, solid chain hardware, and the foreground rail crossing S01-V03 are not outer timber edges.
classification.eagle: Forward of F=60.5 the backing follows the actual S01 face/eagle outline; no backing is added above or below the eagle and no backing fills its concavities.

bowsprit_clearance_station.note: Closest parallel span; nominal minimum clearance governs.

clearance.method: Source line separation between the upper envelope and the bowsprit underside, reduced to the nearest parallel station; CAD clearance tolerance is 0.005 ft.
clearance.measured_note: Actual exported backing/upper-shoulder to bowsprit minimum separation 21.17 mm (0.0695 ft); common volume zero.

assumptions.inboard_section: Keep the existing half-foot-wide common longhead backing and 1.44 in facing thickness; S04-V01/V02 do not independently dimension the side-timber width.
assumptions.forward_transition: The envelope follows the source head silhouette and closes over the S01 eagle; the final fitted closure is an inferred hand transition.
assumptions.hidden_interfaces: Aft root, stem/head fairing and any concealed joint are fitted to the existing accepted structure.

implementation.backing: Enlarged common longhead backing cut to the outer envelope; fitted seats cut against stem, cross-timber and stem-head extension.
implementation.upper_shoulder: Aft shoulder piece above the stem-head extension; separate registered timber with fitted contact faces.
implementation.facing: Existing S01-V03 faces, paint field and relief retained unchanged and seated on the backing.

lower_stem_fairing.note: Tangent lower fairing fused into the single backing solid. The outer Bezier leaves the backing lower edge at P0 with the backing tangent (radius, no sharp corner), descends to the stem/forefoot, and is cut to fitted faces against stem, hull, keel and worm shoe. The former separate fairing part is withdrawn.
